subject: Model run demo — sequencing next steps & agenda alignment
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@pathway-ai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 17:23:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up + scheduling the ops/deep-dive

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the intro earlier. The team at Pathway loved the performance numbers you shared and would like to get a 60–90 minute technical session with our ML infra and SRE leads to walk through a model-run demo and validate latency/cost assumptions.

High-level asks from our side: 
- A short (10–15m) architecture walk, focusing on serving runtime and caching behavior.
- A model run (30–40m) showing end-to-end inference for a 4k-token sequence and an embedding pass.
- A brief Q&A on quantization/throughput knobs and any enterprise networking constraints (VPC options).

Ideal attendees from our side: myself, Priya Rao (ML infra), and Jerome Patel (SRE).

Can you propose two 60–90m windows next week (Nov 16–20)? We are PST. Also let us know if you need any preflight artifacts or data samples.

Thanks — Samira

Samira Khan
Head of ML Ops
Pathway AI
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + scheduling the ops/deep-dive

Samira — appreciated, great to hear the team wants to dig in. Looping in Ben (platform lead) and Mateo (solutions engineer) who will lead the demo.

We can do two provisional slots next week (all PST):
1) Tue Nov 17, 10:00–11:30 PST (90m) — best for a full model run + Q&A
2) Thu Nov 19, 13:00–14:15 PST (75m) — tighter run, focused on latency/cost knobs

Proposed agenda (flexible):
- 5m quick introductions / goals (Samira)
- 10m Redwood architecture overview (Ben) — serving runtime + routing policies
- 35–45m model run demo (Mateo) — 4k token generation + embedding pipeline, show KV caching behavior and streaming latency
- 15–20m configuration levers (quantization, batching, routing) + unit cost back-of-envelope (Ben)
- 10–15m open Q&A and next steps (all)

Precall asks from your side: one representative input sample (anonymized) and a short list of expected concurrency patterns (typical requests/sec and 99th pct lat SLO). We attached a short precall checklist and a draft mutual action plan to accelerate procurement.

If either slot works, we can send a calendar invite and include the internal runbook owner. If you need a different day/time, provide a couple of alternatives and we will try to accommodate.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
